title: Find a mobile phone recycling location
summary: Find out how and where to recycle all brands and types of mobile phones, batteries, chargers, and accessories in NSW.
intro:
You can recycle all brands and types of mobile phones including their batteries, chargers and accessories through MobileMuster.

There are free drop-off locations throughout NSW or free postage options for up to 15kg of mobile phones and accessories.

The following products are also accepted at your local Telstra, Optus or Vodafone stores:

MobileMuster is a recycling program accredited by the federal government.
